119th CONGRESS
  1st Session
                                H. R. 9003

  To establish an example grant program, and for other purposes.

SECTION 1. SHORT TITLE.

    This Act may be cited as the ``Example Grants Act''.

SEC. 2. GRANT PROGRAM.

    (a) In General.--The Secretary shall award grants to States for example purposes.
    (b) Amount.--Each grant shall be not more than $1,000,000.

SEC. 3. REPORT.

    Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment, the Secretary shall submit a report to Congress.
